details.selection_rule_reason: painting-catalog.json's raw used_count (atelier=7, studio=7) is stale, as prior runs (023-025) also found. True counts, cross-checked against every posts/*/status.json history entry and matching post folder titles against the catalog's used-title lists: through post 025, Atelier = 11 (003,004,007,009,011,014,016,018,020,022,024), Studio = 12 (005,006,008,010,012,013,015,017,019,021,023,025). Atelier has fewer true uses (11 < 12), so this run drew from Atelier -- no tiebreak needed. Within Atelier's truly-unused entries (excluding catalog-listed 'unused' titles already used in posts 016/018/020/022/024, which the catalog itself hadn't updated), 'Awakened Fields' was the first clean, unflagged entry: no caution_note, no price_note/availability_note, and a human-verified chosen_images block. Two riskier Atelier candidates were deliberately passed over: 'Heaven Declares' (catalog caution_note flags Psalm 19 overlap with post 004) and 'Let Our Light Continue to Shine' (SOLD OUT / 0 stock plus sensitive Hanukkah/Jewish liturgical content -- neither is a hard skip_rules trigger, but both carry more risk for an unattended automated run than a clean alternative that was available).
